raw_html: [[Sun Burst]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Sun Burst]]:''' This weapon flashes an intense burst of sunlight on any critical hit. The target is blasted for 6 to 36 of light damage and is [[blinded]] as well. [[Ooze]]s and [[Undead]] take 12 to 72 light damage. A successful DC 22 [[Reflex save]] reduces the damage by half and negates the blindness.
